title: Company B – bond measured at amortised cost (exam 2023)
text: Company B issued 5,000 bonds with a nominal value of €100 on 1 January N1 for an issue price of €90 per bond. The bond pays a coupon of 6% at the end of every year; the effective interest rate is 7%. The bonds are redeemed at the end of N10 at nominal value.
